content: MapLibre GL JS (free, open-source Mapbox GL v1 fork, BSD license) + third-party vector tiles (MapTiler free tier, or self-hosted) is the most cost-effective map stack for a bootstrapped PWA -- zero per-load fees vs Mapbox (--.50/1k loads) or Google Maps (/1k loads). Mapbox free tier (50k loads/mo) is fine at very low scale but introduces vendor lock-in and per-request billing as usage grows.
